description: Get detailed match statistics for a specific match ID. Returns per-team stats for the match and for each set: points won, break points converted, longest streak, aces, double faults, and points won on first/second serve and return. Only available for matches of these tournament levels: finals, fip_other, fip_platinum, major, p1, p2.

match_id.description: ID of the match to retrieve stats for

name: show-match-stats
